{{Quote|I'd hoped it would be a little cooler at night once we got inside the caldera, but it looks like nothing ever cools down on this hunk of rock.|Sian Jeisel|<ref name="Republic 75">[[Republic 75|''Republic'' 75]]</ref>}}
'''Saleucami''' {{Pronounced|sʌ'lukəˌmaɪ}} was a dim, arid [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. An economic powerhouse and major trading center in the Outer Rim, Saleucami was politically powerful during the [[Great Galactic War]] and a strategically held world within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Controlled by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] throughout the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the world was liberated by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was spared the retribution demanded of other former Separatist worlds. Located along the [[Talcene Transit/Legends|Talcene Transit]], the planet was supplied by cargo ships off of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] that were headed to the [[Kuthic Worlds/Legends|Kuthic Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Description==
[[File:Saleucami_caldera_city.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Saleucami's capital city and main spaceport, Taleucema.]]

Saleucami was a dim, arid world with scattered oases of plant growth. Its name, Saleucami, meant "oasis" in [[Wroonian]]; a word which was fitting for the only habitable planet within a system filled with dead, uninhabitable worlds and meteors. These meteors would frequently cross paths with the planet's orbit and would bombard its surface creating huge craters and calderas. Overtime, geothermal vents and subterranean water opened up within these craters, creating circular seas and turning some calderas into life-filled pockets on the planet's surface. Ranging from desert to wetlands, the terrain on Saleucami was as diverse as its colonists. Saleucami had no indigenous sentient species, but with its pleasant climate for most of the year outside of the scorching hot equatorial regions, many settlers came to find their own oasis. Among the most prominent species were the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. These colonists lived in tiny townships within the mineral-rich, fertile craters of the world. Establishing Taleucema as the planet's major spaceport and capital, the location was chosen for its system of subterranean magma streams and geothermal vents. Harnessing the natural power of these features, the city-dwellers used the vents to power the city and provide warmth during the freezing desert nights. Diversity among the ecosystems created in these craters was marveled at by the local Saleucamians and visitors alike. Vast tracts of woodland would be broken up by deserts and swamps, while thick jungles filled with predators appeared elsewhere.<ref name="MPQ" />

==Culture==
The culture on Saleucami primarily developed out of the Wroonian heritage, as they were the first settlers on the world. Based around the tenants of freedom of expression, the pursuit of happiness, and an explorer's spirit, the world blossomed on the Outer Rim, attracting many diverse species to its crater cities. As more and more cultures arrived, Saleucami's welcoming stance allowed for and encouraged full, cultural assimilation of different viewpoints. The Gran and Twi'lek settlers brought much influence to the world, and had the greatest impact on Saleucami's cultural practices. The more insular Weequays differed in that they kept to their own self-contained neighborhoods and were not as culturally present as other species.<ref name="MPQ" />

Because the summer months saw dramatic temperature increases, most settlers did their business at night, choosing to remain indoors during the day. This period of the evening was known as Eventide, and became a holiday of sorts for the first Wroonian settlers. Serving midday meals at midnight, the Pantorans reversed their schedules for the three months of summer and were highly active in the evenings.<ref name="MPQ" />

==History==
===Old Republic===
{{Quote|The people of Saleucami and the other conquered worlds send their gratitude. The enemy has retreated to their home system.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:IFHS">{{TORcite|type=other|[Intro] Flashpoint: Hammer Station}}</ref>}}
Saleucami was originally colonized by Wroonian in [[6100 BBY]], dwelling within the fertile calderas outside of the equatorial zones.<ref name="MPQ" /> As more and more settlers heard of the original colonists' successes, members of other species flocked to the world to establish thriving enclaves there as well. Overtime, the Saleucamians had developed defense systems which prevented meteor impact by blasting incoming space debris to dust before it entered the atmosphere.<ref name="MPQ" /> Having found much success at developing an economic hub on the Outer Rim, Saleucami's government enjoyed strong political clout within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[File:Hammer_Saleucami.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Hammer Station]]'s main weapon aiming at Saleucami]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Saleucami was targeted by the xenophobic and expansionist faction known as the [[Advozse Hegemony]]. The [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] planned to use the [[Hammer Station]] battle station to bombard the planet<ref name="TOR:IFHS" /> but the station was eventually destroyed during a [[Battle for Hammer Station|battle]]<ref name="TOR:TH">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Hammer}}</ref> in Saleucami space.<ref name="TOR:IFHS" />

During the [[Great Galactic War]], the planet was often spoken of as the Outer Rim's most prosperous trading hub. Repeated Republic losses, including a [[Battle above Saleucami|devastating orbital battle]] caused the planet's government to doubt the Republic's ability to defend its allies, and Saleucami became one of the founding members of the [[Rift Alliance]], with the blunt-spoken Senator [[Alauni]] as its representative. The actions of the third [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Barsen'thor]] convinced the Rift Alliance worlds, including Saleucami, to remain allied to the Republic, with Alauni as one of three possible candidates to represent the alliance in the Galactic Senate.

===Rise of the Empire and Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Saleucami has fallen, and Master Vos moved his troops to Boz Pity.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="RotS" />}}
As a thriving world, Saleucami attracted all sorts of visitors seeking solitude an anonymity. Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Unidentified Iktotchi prophet|female]] had a cult following on Saleucami. Possessing an innate gift for prophecy, the Iktotchi predicted the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as well as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Following information stolen from [[Darth Venamis]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] came to Saleucami and listened to the prophet. Concerned that the prophet would prematurely reveal his [[Grand Plan/Legends|plans]], Plagueis electrocuted her with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and killed her.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

[[File:Saleucami_forest.png|thumb|right|250px|Two commando droid snipers hide among the planet's vegetation.]]
Despite its best efforts to remain a peaceful oasis, Saleucami came under direct control of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[35 BBY/Legends|three years before]] the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, its ties to the Techno Union placed it squarely under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As a result, the planet was named by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as part of a "[[Triad of Evil/Legends|Triad of Evil]]," alongside [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] once led a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|mission]] to rescue [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who was in orbit around Saleucami at the time.<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> When the ship was destroyed the Jedi searched for Grievous in a forested area of the planet. This led to a small skirmish during which [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," was injured. While healing, Rex also discovered a [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|clone deserter]] living as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] with his [[Lawquane family/Legends|adopted family]]. Rex then helped the deserter and his family with an abandoned pod containing [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]].<ref name="TD" />

Despite the population's desire to remain out of the war, the Confederacy used the planet as a staging area during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Unbeknownst to the Saleucamian government, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] had begun to convert several of the worlds underground caverns into cloning facilities for their own [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Morgukai Shadow Army|army]]—[[Morgukai]] clones trained by [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] assassins. Despite their efforts at secrecy, this plot was discovered by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. As a result, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] sent [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] and his second-in-command [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] along with a task force to destroy the cloning operations on Saleucami. This would start a [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|massive five month-long siege]] between the Republic and the Separatist forces on the planet. First, the Republic captured Saleucami's main city and then fought their way inward.

[[File:Saleucamibattleground.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Saleucami during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
During the conflict, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Rancisis was murdered by his former friend, [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], after being distracted by [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] assassins. Sora Bulq and [[Tol Skorr]] were later killed by Quinlan Vos and [[Bok]] was slain by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. The Republic forces also flooded Saleucami's magma tunnels to kill the Separatist Morgukai clones. Despite heavy losses on both sides, Saleucami's infrastructure was not heavily damaged, as most of the fighting occurred in the unpopulated desert regions. Maintaining a strong economy after the Republic established an interim government to lead the planet through post-battle clean-up and recovery efforts, the Saleucamians embraced the Grand Army's presence and lauded them as saviors.<ref name="MPQ" /> Leading Republic clean-up efforts was Jedi Master [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]]. While patrolling the battlefield for remaining Confederate forces in a unit of [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|BARC troopers]], Neyo received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] over a secure comm channel. Neyo and his lieutenant fired upon Allie's [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], destroying the vehicle and killing the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] instantly.<ref name="RotS" />

===Imperial era and later history===
{{Quote|I want this planet in my pocket!|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="FoC" />}}
[[File:Saleucami_Landscape_MPQ.png|thumb|rihjt|250px|Saleucami landscape during the time of the Galactic Empire]]
As the Republic transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Saleucami's place within the galaxy remained unchanged. An [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] was installed in the region to ensure the planet's loyalty to Coruscant; though the governor came to be on the payroll of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].<ref name="MPQ" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had some holdings and a secret communications outpost on Saleucami, which were [[Battle of Saleucami (Zann Consortium)|captured]] and eventually forcibly handed over to [[Tyber Zann]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="FoC" /> Around the same time, the space above the planet was also the site of a [[Skirmish over Saleucami|skirmish]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces of [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], and Imperial troops, led by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], which led to the capture of most of the Rebels on the mission.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Saleucami was [[Battle of the Saleucami system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pronunciation is somewhat in dispute, depending on what one considers canon. In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], Obi-Wan Kenobi pronounces /sʌ'lukəˌmaɪ/, while in [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption|''Forces of Corruption'']] characters pronounce /ˈsæl.jʊˌkɑ.mi/. [[Col Serra]] pronounces is /ˈseɪ.liˌuːkɑ.mi/ in ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''. The difference could be attributed to [[Ewan McGregor]]'s Scottish accent. Characters in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] also use the /sʌ'lukəˌmaɪ/ pronunciation, indicating that it is likely the correct pronunciation. In ''Star Wars The Old Republic'', however, Master Satele Shan pronounces it /ˌsuːl.jʊ.kɑˈmiː/.

[[File:Saleucami_TEA.jpg|thumb|200px|Saleucami in ''The Essential Atlas'']]
In ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Saleucami is pictured as having a light purple surface. This is most likely an error because all other sources show Saleucami as a brownish-green planet.

During pre-production of ''Revenge of the Sith'', Saleucami was given to a concept called "bridge planet," a world made up of arcing parabolic bridges with upside-down skylines extending from the curving frames. This planet was to be a major stronghold of the [[Techno Union]], when a Clone Wars montage was to portray the engagement of the Confederacy founders on their respective homeworlds.

The bridge world concept evolved and became [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in the finished film. Saleucami was then reassigned to the planet where [[Stass Allie]] had been killed.<ref name="db" />

The [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' describes Saleucami as a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] colony,<ref name="TEA" /> while the [[2015]] sourcebook ''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]'' describes it as a Pantoran colony.<ref name="MPQ" /> This is assumed to be a mistake, due to the similar traits of the two species.
